scope: All allies receive their normal first selection before the strict browsing invariant, with exact expected TurnsStarted initialization checked and recorded. Two actual Director boards: main episode 1 with its two joined allies and an isolated Lv25 six-ally training fixture. Both at 1920x1080 and 1280x720, covering command, skills, ground facing, legal target forecasts, enemy hover, left/right camera pans and zoom with larger text. Thirty-two unedited ScreenCapture PNGs.
checks: Fixed status bounds; command/status separation; removal of persistent objective and facing instruction text; active button center raycasts; actual UI submit to skill/wait and cancel; visible glyph/frame/screen boundaries; short overhead labels; camera/selection/menu browsing state, grid, RNG and campaign invariance; hashes of all top-level user-storage files except the two explicitly listed Unity live logs.
limitations: Programmatic UI submit and Unity EventSystem raycasts are not operating-system mouse/keyboard automation. Only the exact case-insensitive top-level names Player.log and Player-prev.log are excluded from user-storage hashing; unknown files, backups and temporary files remain included. Nested files and directory paths require an external wrapper. Opening boards do not prove a campaign playthrough, balance, all resolutions, all six-person arrangements or manual visual approval. Edge rows record achieved actor positions because map panning remains bounded. Inspect PNGs for artwork and occlusion.
